subject: One-minute ask after our demo — where does this land for your team?
messages:
From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood-inference.com>
To: Samira Khan <samira@clarityai.com>, ClarityAI Procurement <procure@clarityai.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood-inference.com>
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: One-minute ask after our demo — where does this land for your team?

Hi Samira — great to connect earlier today. Quick recap and one ask: would you mind telling me, in one sentence, whether the capabilities we showed map to a near-term need for ClarifyAI (yes / maybe / not right now)?

Recap (2 bullets):
- What we demoed: high-throughput hosted API, dedicated capacity for predictable throughput, routing policies to control cost/latency.
- What you said: primary constraints are procurement timeline and data residency for model traces; you want a predictable cost profile for pilot (team of ~8, ~250k tokens/month).

One ask: if you can reply with a single word ("yes"/"maybe"/"no") and, if "yes" or "maybe", pick a preferred next step from the two below:
- 15-minute pricing + procurement checklist call (I can include our solutions engineer)
- Intro to procurement (you share contact) and I’ll send a compact procurement packet + license summary

I attached the demo deck. Happy to answer any follow-ups — if easier, here’s a 15-min link: https://meet.redwood.com/alex/15

Thanks,
Alex Martinez
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
alex.martinez@redwood-inference.com
(415) 555-0182

Attachment: clarity_demo_deck.pdf

---
[Internal note: flagged for follow-up in CRM in 3 business days.]

From: Samira Khan <samira@clarityai.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood-inference.com>
Cc: ClarityAI Procurement <procure@clarityai.com>
Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: One-minute ask after our demo — where does this land for your team?

Thanks Alex — quick reply: maybe. We liked the routing/cost controls but the decision has been pushed toward the back half of Q3 to Q4 because of an internal roadmap re-prioritization. Procurement is looping in a couple of standard security checks (SOC2 evidence, retention).

Two quick asks from our side if you can share:
- Very rough ballpark pricing for a small pilot (8 seats, 250k tokens/month) — ballpark is fine.
- SOC2 summary / one-pager we can share internally (procurement folks want something compact).

I cc’d procurement on this thread (procure@clarityai.com) so they have context.

Samira Khan
Director of ML Engineering | ClarityAI
samira@clarityai.com

Resources I’m attaching here to make internal meetings easier:
- SOC2 one-pager (SOC2-one-pager.pdf) — short summary procurement usually accepts for early diligence.
- Demo recording (demo_recording-20270510.mp4) — 6m highlight reel of the parts you flagged.

If it’s still a maybe, I can get our solutions engineer on a 15-min call to give a quick pricing sketch and maps to your constraints. Book a slot: https://meet.redwood.com/alex/15

If you prefer, I can also drop a compact procurement packet directly into procure@clarityai.com — say the word and I’ll send it this afternoon.

Thanks for the quick signal,
Alex
